quotes.text: And, first, I would counsel and exhort, that when you assemble to commemorate the death of your Lord, and to partake of the elements of bread and wine, in remembrance of what he has done for you, then, without fail, make ye a collection for the poor amongst you, that their necessities may be ministered unto, and that the blessing of God may be in your midst continually.
